title: LLM-Based Multi-Task Bangla Hate Speech Detection: Type, Severity, and Target
findings: The 'Religious Hate' category was found to be an underrepresented class in the collected dataset, appearing at a low frequency across all severity levels compared to other types of hate speech like 'Abusive' or 'Political Hate'.
